reviewer: Current Codex inspected all100 literal query/target pairs without prior reasons. Same reviewer, not independent gold.

How many dollars did Final Destination gross in the United States and Canada?
50.reason: Keep US-and-Canada as the joint comparison operand; splitting a commonly jointly reported figure adds unnecessary retrieval requirements.
